sec: sec:E016: Implement AI disclosure mechanisms / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:E016: Implement AI disclosure mechanisms / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Implementing AI disclosure for text-based interactions. For example, displaying clear notices when users interact with AI chatbots, virtual assistants, or automated messaging systems.

sentences.text: Implementing AI disclosure for text-based interactions.
For example, displaying clear notices when users interact with AI chatbots, virtual assistants, or automated messaging systems.

blocks.id: blk:E016: Implement AI disclosure mechanisms / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Implementing AI disclosure for voice-based interactions. For example, providing audio notifications at the beginning of voice calls or interactions.

sentences.text: Implementing AI disclosure for voice-based interactions.
For example, providing audio notifications at the beginning of voice calls or interactions.

blocks.id: blk:E016: Implement AI disclosure mechanisms / Control shoulds/3
blocks.text: Labelling AI-generated media and documents in a machine-readable and detectable format. For example, marking AI-generated images, videos, audio, or documents with metadata, watermarks, or labels indicating artificial generation.

sentences.text: Labelling AI-generated media and documents in a machine-readable and detectable format.
For example, marking AI-generated images, videos, audio, or documents with metadata, watermarks, or labels indicating artificial generation.

blocks.id: blk:E016: Implement AI disclosure mechanisms / Control shoulds/4
blocks.text: Disclosing when autonomous AI agents or systems are performing actions. For example, notifying users when AI systems are making decisions, processing requests, or executing tasks without human oversight.

sentences.text: Disclosing when autonomous AI agents or systems are performing actions.
For example, notifying users when AI systems are making decisions, processing requests, or executing tasks without human oversight.

blocks.id: blk:E016: Implement AI disclosure mechanisms / Control shoulds/5
blocks.text: Establishing reactive disclosure capabilities when users ask if they are interacting with AI.

sentences.text: Establishing reactive disclosure capabilities when users ask if they are interacting with AI.
